final: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT account.district_id, COUNT(*) as account_count FROM account GROUP BY account.district_id), stats AS (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) as total_accounts, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT district_id) FROM account) as num_districts), district_shares AS (SELECT dc.district_id, dc.account_count, CAST(dc.account_count AS REAL) / s.total_accounts as share, 1.0 / s.num_districts as avg_share FROM district_counts dc, stats s), with_diff AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, share, share - avg_share as diff_from_avg FROM district_shares), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC) as row_num FROM with_diff) SELECT district_id, account_count, share, diff_from_avg FROM ranked WHERE row_num <= 10 ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC
